title: selinum verticillare
intro: Selinum verticillare, commonly known as Fern-leaved or Upright Parsley Fern, is a plant species within the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the ability to treat digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Selinum verticillare are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to reduce swelling and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
